title: AI Collections Assistant
tagline: Prioritize overdue invoices and draft follow-ups.
summary: Reviews outstanding invoices, due dates, customer history, and payment patterns to prioritize collections and draft follow-up messages.
businessProblem: Outstanding invoices pile up because owners avoid awkward collection conversations — cash sits in AR while they focus on delivery work.
outcome: Weekly prioritized collections list with suggested follow-up emails ranked by amount, age, and customer payment history — drafts ready for owner approval.
expectedOutcomes: Weekly prioritized collections list with suggested follow-up emails ranked by amount, age, and customer payment history — drafts ready for owner approval.
whoItsFor: B2B service businesses and clinics with net-30 invoicing and $10K+ in outstanding AR at any time.
aiInputs: All open invoices with amount, age, and due date
Customer payment history (average days to pay)
Prior follow-up thread history if available
Business tone guide for collection messages
aiOutputs: Prioritized collections queue with urgency score
Draft follow-up email per invoice (escalating tone by age)
Summary of total AR and aging buckets
Flag for disputes or credits needed before contacting
Suggested call vs email channel per customer
noCodeTools: QuickBooks overdue report + ChatGPT draft emails
Zapier: QBO overdue trigger → GPT → Gmail draft
lowCodeTools: n8n weekly: QBO AR aging → OpenAI → Gmail drafts
customBuildStack: Gmail draft API — never auto-send without approval
implementationSteps: Define aging buckets and escalation tone rules
Owner reviews and sends — track responses in spreadsheet
Measure DSO monthly to tune priority rules
systemBehavior: Weekly batch — not real-time on invoice creation
Draft-only emails — owner must approve and send
Escalates tone at 30/60/90 day marks per policy
Skips customers with open disputes or credit memos
Collections support only — not legal debt collection
risks: Aggressive collection tone can damage client relationships
AI may contact wrong person if CRM data is stale
Legal collection limits vary — this is friendly AR follow-up only
Writing off bad debt still requires human judgment
